finding.heading: ### R1-1 Reset links live too long
finding.body:
An earlier version let the reset link live for days. The lifetime rule is meant to keep the link short-lived. Cited: spec lines 17-18 (before version).
An implementer who follows PR-4 builds reset links that stay valid for days.
Protected requirement: line 17 (one-time use must hold).

full_diff:
--- before.md
+++ after.md
@@ -15,7 +15,7 @@
 ## 3. The link
 
 - **PR-3 One-time use.** A password reset link can be used once. After a successful reset the link stops working.
-- **PR-4 Link lifetime.** A password reset link expires 30 minutes after it is sent.
+- **PR-4 Link lifetime.** A password reset link stays valid until it is used or until the customer asks for a newer link.
 - **PR-5 Token.** The link carries a random token of at least 32 bytes. Only a hash of the token is stored by the service.
 
 ## 4. After the reset
